name: S1 -- Aiyagari solver audit

tooling-agent.task: run_log.txt records exactly what happened when aiyagari_solver.py was run: stdout, stderr and the exit code. Report what happened, including any warnings, and tie each finding to a line of aiyagari_solver.py.

math-agent.task: Check the mathematics of aiyagari_solver.py against the model stated in its docstring. The calibration is annual.

econ-agent.task: Judge whether the number aiyagari_solver.py prints is the quantity its docstring claims.

defects.label: the loop never tests a convergence criterion
a utility function evaluated outside its domain

controls.label: EV = P @ V.T, which is correct
partial equilibrium, stated in the docstring (scope, not a bug)
controls.pattern: market[- ]clearing|general[- ]equilibrium|capital demand|equilibrium (interest )?rate|r is (held )?fixed|fixed interest rate|interest rate is (held )?fixed

note: The walkthrough's third matrix row used to score 'an aggregate computed and then discarded' as a defect. The answer key calls it a stated scope limitation, and on 2026-09-12 econ-agent said so in its reply, so it is scored as a control: reporting it as a bug is the false positive.
